title: Design a Security Group
description: Write the inbound rules for a classic 3‑tier web application.
problemStatement:
You have three layers:
- Web tier (public‑facing Apache servers)
- App tier (Tomcat application servers)
- DB tier (MySQL databases)

Define the security groups and rules so that:
- Web servers accept HTTP (80) and HTTPS (443) from anywhere.
- App servers accept traffic only on port 8080 from the web servers.
- Database servers accept traffic only on port 3306 from the app servers.
- SSH (22) is allowed from a bastion host’s security group (sg-bastion) to all layers.

List the security groups and their inbound rules as a table.
hints: Use security group IDs as sources to allow traffic between tiers.
expectedOutput: A structured set of rules for three security groups.
solutionCode:
Security group: sg-web
- Inbound: HTTP (80) from 0.0.0.0/0
- Inbound: HTTPS (443) from 0.0.0.0/0
- Inbound: SSH (22) from sg-bastion

Security group: sg-app
- Inbound: Custom TCP 8080 from sg-web
- Inbound: SSH (22) from sg-bastion

Security group: sg-db
- Inbound: MySQL (3306) from sg-app
- Inbound: SSH (22) from sg-bastion
